entities.summary: Abd al-Rahman ibn Rustum was an Ibadi leader and the first imam associated with the polity later known as the Rustamud Imamate in the Maghreb, whose capital and principal center of rule was established at Tihert. Abd al-Rahman ibn Rustum was a missionaries from Iraq (720 CE, Iraq–788 CE). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
